description: This Java class 'Calls' provides utility methods for executing Retrofit `Call` objects, handling success responses, and exception management, intended for simplifying API call executions in the Fineract client.

classes.name: Calls
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to execute Retrofit 'Call' objects with built-in success handling and exception translation.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Executes a Retrofit call expecting a successful response and returns the body; throws if the call fails or response is not successful.

methods.name: okR
methods.description: Executes a Retrofit call expecting success and returns the full Response object; throws if the call fails or response is not successful.

methods.name: executeU
methods.description: Executes a Retrofit call, mapping IOExceptions to runtime exceptions; returns the Response object regardless of success.
